beatWatch.line: 📺 "CLEARED THE BOARD! Every last one of them — ON CAMERA! The audience is still chanting your name, you beautiful violent overachievers!"
📺 "But real talk? The next act needs a BIGGER STAGE. I can't stage it with ONE fire — there's not enough of you to REFLECT, you feel me? Get me STANDING — bloo

govWatch.line: Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.
Something moves out there — Night Court.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Night Court is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
🔥 The fire settles. Keisha has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and
⚔️ Keisha killed the Night Court with their party — 3 rounds, 23 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
Siriwan sets out for Night Court. "Meat's meat. Back with it or not at all."
Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.
◈ SYSTEM: "Four fires. One head. GOVERNANCE LAYER: online — polity tribute routing, the court calendar, famine reserves. You built a realm. Try not to lose it the way you found it."
👑 Speakers from Stonebridge, Emberhold, Ashford ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Have
🍲 The shared granary opens: 5,000 kcal for every fire of the realm, no strings. Stonebridge, Emberhold, Ashford count it — and remember who fed them first. (Trust +10 with each.)
You don't know what that was. A walking courthouse. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
It is a courthouse. Do not eat the courthouse.
